questions.question: If 25 March 1995 is a Saturday, then what will be the day of the week on 12 December 1997?
questions.solution:
We have, 25 March 1995 is Saturday.

Since 1996 is leap year = 2 odd days. So, 25 March 1996 = Saturday + 2 = Monday

Again 1997 is ordinary year = 1 odd day. So 25 March 1997 = Monday +1 = Tuesday

Next, we will count the remaining days = 6 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 12 = 262 ÷ 7 = 3 odd days

Thus, on 12 Dec 1997 = Tuesday + 3 = Friday

Hence, the correct answer is **"Friday".**

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row: 54, 72, 90

Second row: 79, 97, 115

Third row: 83, 101, ?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the number into its constituent digits. For example, 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic here is:

**Logic: Each term is added by 18 to get the next term of the same row. **

First row → 54 + 18 = 72 ⇒ 72 + 18 = 90

And,

Second row → 79 + 18 = 97 ⇒ 97 + 18 = 115,

Similarly,

Third row → 83 + 18 = 101 ⇒ 101 + 18 = 119

Hence, the correct answer is **"119"**.

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

options.text: R a K a N K a
K a K a N K a
R a K a N R a
R a R a N K a

questions.solution:
Here, we need to find the missing blanks

The logic here is: Make of group of 1st seven letters.

Given: K a _ _ N _ a K _ R a _ K a _a R _ N K a

1) R a K a N K a: K a R a N K a - K a R a N K a - K a R a N K a

4) R a R a N K a: K a R a N R a - K a R a N K a - K a R a N K a

From this we can say the pattern: K a **R a** N **K** a - K **a** R a **N** K a - **K **a R **a** N K a 

Hence, the missing blanks is '__**R a K a N K a**__'.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(50, 10, 15)

(60, 10, 16)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(3rd number - 2nd number) × 2nd number = 1st number**.

Now,

For, (50, 10, 15)

→ (15 - 10) × 10

→ 5 × 10 = 50.

For, (60, 10, 16)

→ (16 - 10) × 10

→ 6 × 10 = 60.

Similarly, for **(60, 15, 19)**

**→ (19 - 15) × 15**

**→ 4 × 15 = 60.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

The pattern followed here is: 

**Logic: **In each pair the 1st number is divided by the 2nd number and the answer is added to the 2nd number to get the 3rd number.

1) (50, 10, 15 ): 50 ÷ 10 = 5, 10 + 5 = 15

2) (60, 10, 16): 60 ÷ 10 = 6, 10 + 6 = 16

Next, we will check all the options one by one:

1) **(60, 15, 19): 60 ÷ 15 = 4, 15 + 4 = 19**

2) (60, 10, 6): 60 ÷ 10 = 6, 10 + 6 = 16 ≠ 6. This is not true. 

3) (80, 20, 16): 80 ÷ 20 = 4, 20 + 4 = 24 ≠16. This is not true. 

4) (80, 6, 15): 80 ÷ 6 = 13.33, 6 + 13.33 = 19.333 ≠ 15. This is not true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"(60, 15, 19)".**

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some strawberries are bananas.

All bananas are avocados.

Some avocados are grapes.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some avocados are bananas.

II. Some grapes are bananas.

III. Some avocados are strawberries.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/841d6c726e73dd29a9efb1024171fb68271eba00c24f03ec5f5a09034deb4bde.png] 

__**Conclusion:**__

I. Some avocados are bananas → Follow → (As all bananas are avocados. So some avocados are bananas is possible. This is true)

II. Some grapes are bananas → Does not follow → (As they have not mentioned the relationship between grapes and bananas. This is not true)

III. Some avocados are strawberries → Follow → (As some strawberries are bananas and all bananas are avocados. So some avocados can be strawberries. This is true)

Hence, the answer is **"Only conclusion I and III follow".**

questions.question:
Each of the seven friends, Misha, Minshu, Mohi, Priya, Veer, Pari and Krishi, has a different height. Krishi is taller than only three people. Pari is taller than only Veer. Misha is taller than Minshu but not Mohi. Priya is taller than Mohi.

Who among the following is taller than Krishi?
questions.solution:
**Explanation : **

 
• Pari is taller than only veer.
 
• Krishi is taller than only three people.

 ** ..... >.......>.......> Krishi .....> Pari > veer**

 
• Misha is taller than Minshu.
 
• Misha is shorter than Mohi.
 
• Priya is taller than Mohi.

 ** Priya > Mohi > Misha > Krishi > Minshu > Pari > Veer**

Hence,** Mohi **is taller than Krishi.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

91 * 13 * 26 * 51 * 18
questions.solution:
**BODMAS rule**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13bc0065c96e715682af7c8a6dc1b4c567b7a2a89597cc68809a5ff942c7e421.png] 

**Option 1) ÷, +, =, −**

**Given expression : 91 * 13 * 26 * 51 * 18**

**After replacing * with ÷, +, =, − respectively, we get**

**⇒ __91 ÷ 13__ + 26 = 51 − 18**

⇒**__ 7 + 26__ = __51 - 18__**

⇒ **33 = __51 - 18__**

⇒ **33 = 33**

Option 2) ×, −, =, +

Given expression : 91 * 13 * 26 * 51 * 18

After replacing * with ×, −, =, + respectively, we get

⇒ __**91 × 13**__ - 26 = 51 + 18

⇒ __**1183 - 26 **__= __**51 + 18**__

⇒ __**1183 - 26**__ = 69

⇒ 1157 ≠ 69

Option 3) ÷, =, +, −

Given expression : 91 * 13 * 26 * 51 * 18

After replacing * with ÷, =, +, − respectively, we get

⇒ __**91 ÷ 13**__ = **__26 + 51__** - 18

⇒ 7 = __**77 - 18**__

⇒ 7 ≠ 59

Option 4) ×, =, −, −

Given expression : 91 * 13 * 26 * 51 * 18

After replacing * with ×, =, −, − respectively, we get

⇒ __**91 **____**× 13**__ = 26 − 51 − 18 

⇒ 1183 = - 43

⇒ 1183 ≠ - 43

Hence, the ** ÷, +, =, −** is the **correct answer**.
